# Cinch

> Remote clipboard for developers. Push from any terminal, pull on any machine.

Cinch is an open-source CLI tool that pipes remote terminal output straight to your local clipboard. It uses a self-hostable WebSocket relay with SQLite persistence for reliable, real-time clipboard delivery across machines. Clips are end-to-end encrypted with AES-256-GCM — the relay stores ciphertext only. Licensed under AGPL-3.0.

## Core Commands

- `cinch push` — Pipe any command output to the relay (e.g., `cat file.txt | cinch push`)
- `cinch pull` — Pull the latest clip to stdout or your local clipboard
- `cinch auth` — Pair devices, check status, or logout

## Key Features

- Unix-native: composable with pipes, works with any command
- WebSocket relay: real-time delivery with SQLite persistence
- Self-hostable: run your own relay server via Docker or binary
- Desktop agent: automatic clipboard sync on macOS (Apple Silicon)
- Fully open source (AGPL-3.0)

## Installation

```bash
curl -fsSL cinchcli.com/install.sh | sh
```
